llms:
Formula For each of 8 directions i (NE, N, NW, W, SW, S, SE, E) walk k = skipRadius+1.. while k*step < 0.99999*searchRadius*cellSizeY and stay inside the raster, ignoring invalid samples; step is the ground size of one step. Height h_k = zFactor*(z_k - z_centre). Zenith = sample maximising h_k/k (height Delta_Z at count k_Z); nadir = sample minimising h_k/k (Delta_N at k_N). With tau = tan(flatThresholdDegrees) a side is over the threshold when |Delta| > tau * k * step (the flat distance, when set and smaller, replaces k*step). anglev1: digit 0 unless one side is over; then digit +1 if |Delta_Z|/k_Z > |Delta_N|/k_N, -1 if smaller, 0 on an exact tie (anglev2 variants resolve ties to +1 or by distance). A direction with an invalid first neighbour or no valid sample has digit 0. m = number of -1 digits, p = number of +1 digits; form = FORM_TABLE[9m + p]: 1 flat, 2 peak, 3 ridge, 4 shoulder, 5 spur, 6 slope, 7 hollow, 8 footslope, 9 valley, 10 pit. Invalid cells and cells within skipRadius+1 of the border get 0.
